comment: Shared areas Tools/Build/team_report.py can report on (Docs/TEAM.md rule 10). One row per area: its paths, owner, who it is for, branch, artifacts, docs, how to test it, and its hand-written report. Add a row when you start a shared area; keep the report doc's top half current by hand, the generated block by `team_report.py area <key> --write`.

regatta-ai.title: Regatta AI
regatta-ai.branchNote: for testing; nothing goes to bleeding-edge until Yash has tested it
regatta-ai.summary: Five hulls racing Regatta with working AIs (Squirrel, Manta, Rhino, Urchin, Dolphin), the host picking every AI seat's hull, the Third Eye showing each AI's path and what it is doing, and a steering fix found in a browser lab and ported to Unity. Tested in the Unity editor only (the lab artifact was deleted 2026-10-16).

artifacts.name: Regatta AI Report (the page for Garrett)

test: Pull Ys-bleeding-edge, open Unity, wait for the compile.
Arcade > Regatta, solo, Hard. Tap the AI chips to seat Squirrel, Manta, Rhino, Urchin and Dolphin. Launch.
FrogletTools > AI > Third Eye, Trails on: each AI reads Approach then Through near a ring; after a missed ring it reads break-off and comes straight back.
Every hull finishes three laps at I1; repeat at I3. Note any hull that does not, and at which ring.

ai-training.title: AI training
ai-training.summary: Training every vessel's AI: the genetic trainer in Unity (studyholic, Garrett, Shombith), situations learned from Unity editor flights (the browser prototype was deleted 2026-10-16), and the plan to an AI Lab scene, Regatta in the trainer, a consented flight recorder and behaviour cloning.
test: Open the artifact's Training tab, pick a hull, Train, then Race trained vs untrained.

team-tools.title: Team tools
team-tools.summary: What every Claude session on this repo gets: the team notices and activity feed (hooks), the task board, who_works_where.py, this report system and the session deck (buttons, status line).

performance.title: Performance
performance.branchNote: developed on perf/performance-optimization, merged into Ys-bleeding-edge on 2026-10-15; the daily check runs on bleeding-edge
performance.summary: The 2x plan (100k prisms at 60 fps on a phone), one-button measurement (capture: burst + diag + prof + renderers + cells + cameras as one JSON), the game's own markers measured in Amoebius with no Unity, baselines, a daily sweep that files a team task per regression, and the /perf-hunt resolve loop.
test: Pull Ys-bleeding-edge, open Unity, Code Optimization = Release, close the Third Eye window.
Play, Cell Selector > Lattice, wait 8 minutes.
Keep playing: the editor captures S2 by itself at 8 minutes (the Scene view badge counts down and says Saved).
Stop playing: the capture goes to Claude by itself.
python3 Tools/Build/perf_hunt.py sweep --write shows the capture judged against its baseline in Docs/Reports/PERFORMANCE.md.

crew-vessels.title: Crew vessels
crew-vessels.branchNote: not on bleeding-edge yet; nothing has been played in the Unity editor
crew-vessels.summary: The first multiplayer vessel, the Wrasse (card: Wrasse and Grouper): one hull, two seats. The pilot flies the Grouper, the hull, on two sticks; the navigator flies the Wrasse, a kite on the hull's x-z plane whose head pops hostile prisms and rams rivals and whose tail lassos navigator-only motes into exponential Space / Mass / Time / Charge effects. Designed in the Crew Vessel Lab (signed off 2026-10-17), ported to Unity with a parity gate, then directed by play in rounds 4-4f; compiled against Unity reference assemblies, not yet played in the editor.
test: Check out cece/compassionate-babbage-gc13io, open Unity, wait for the compile and the shader import.
Open the Toybox, fly into the Vessel Changer and fly the Wrasse and Grouper station (a Sparrow body): the kite view is a small square in the lower left and the AI flies the kite.
Press 2 (or D-pad right) to take the kite: its view fills the screen and the hull's shrinks to the corner. The kite follows the mouse or stick; loop motes of one petal shape. Press 1 to fly again.
Run the steps of the Kite Navigator entry in Docs/UNITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md.

mobile-vessels.title: Vessels on a phone
mobile-vessels.summary: A read-only audit of all 18 vessels on touch: what a phone pilot can trigger, what does not translate (thumb lift to reach a card fires an ability, no trigger depth, no LT+RT, FlipAction dead), 18 bounded fixes (Urchin reverses on let-go, Scarab cannot thrust) and 12 design decisions, plus the unmeasured phone performance risks.
test: Build an Android development APK (Docs/ANDROID_BUILD.md) and run Docs/Reports/MOBILE_VESSELS.md section 6 in the Toybox Vessel Changer.
